latest_release.name: 3.4.0 Big text editor changes, OneDrive, SCIM and Accessibility checker
latest_release.body:
A big release!  Lots of changes in this release around the PDF Text Editor, such as it now works directly inside the viewer by clicking the edit text button in the top bar. 
Other changes for it include: 

- It can use fonts from the server including any custom provided fonts that are placed in customFiles/static/fonts/.
- It does a much better job of matching scanned (OCRed) documents to their fonts
- Brand new font picker for those OCR scenarios
- General text editor fixes for typed text and lag issues
- Embedded fonts are now subset, so saved files are smaller.

Other features in this release include: 
- OneDrive support has been added to our pro plan with more to come soon
- Brand new check PDF accessibility tool which checks PDFs against PDF/UA-1 or PDF/UA-2 and generates reports (More to come soon!)
- New setup wizard for new server setups to help onboard users easier 
- Enterprise users get SCIM 2.0 user provisioning
- Admins concerned about users editting and invalidating signatures can now disable users from doing that, this also comes with a new signature detection interface

Other changes are:
- New settings menu submenu with easy access logout button
- Custom page size option for Scale Pages
- New “Clear recents” button in the file sidebar
- Odd-even merge in Reorganize Pages
- Pixel comparison mode is back in the Compare tool
- Metadata updates can now keep the fields you leave out (keepOmitted=true)
- The feedback button is back (admins can turn it off with system.enableFeedback: false)
- Faster desktop startup with large temp folders and on first launch
- Desktop keeps open files locked on Windows so a DMS doesn’t check them in
- Lots of dependency updates

We also fixed some bugs including:

- Page numbers being placed wrong on rotated and cropped pages
- Uploads from Safari not always sending correctly
- A held-back file drop leaving the desktop UI stuck
- MCP convert tool missing its convert operation, and AI engine errors not showing as MCP tool errors


This release also includes several security and stability improvements

Note: the PostScript vector conversion endpoints have been removed (/convert/vector/pdf for PS/EPS to PDF, and /convert/pdf/vector for PDF to PS/EPS/PCL/XPS)

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes
* refactor(convert)!: remove PostScript vector conversion endpoints by @balazs-szucs in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8735
### Bug Fixes
* fix: implement odd-even merge in reorganize pages by @SomSamantray in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/7649
* fix(desktop): slide the tool view instead of using a View Transition by @EthanHealy01 in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8680
* fix(editor): PWA name respects configured appName by @SomSamantray in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/7420
* fix(desktop): keep the installed version visible when updates are managed off by @samuelsl27 in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8437
* fix(page-numbers): place numbers correctly on rotated and cropped pages by @yuvrajtiwary-bitmesraece in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8896
* fix(mcp): surface AI engine HTTP client errors as MCP tool errors by @VISHAL55UIET in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8944
* fix(mcp): expose convert op in stirling_convert tool with tests by @Azadan in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8673
* fix(security): stream stored job files instead of loading them into heap by @reecebrowne in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8688
* fix(saas): serialise first-request user provisioning to stop duplicate-key errors by @ConnorYoh in https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/pull/8935
### Enhancements
* chore(rust): add Clippy to Rust crates, tasks, and CI by @balazs-szucs in https://github

detail.readme:
Stirling PDF - The Open-Source PDF Platform

Stirling PDF is a powerful, open-source PDF editing platform. Run it as a personal desktop app, in the browser, or deploy it on your own servers with a private API. Edit, sign, redact, convert, and automate PDFs without sending documents to external services.

![Stirling PDF - Dashboard](docs/images/home-light.png) ## Key Capabilities - **Everywhere you work** - Desktop client, browser UI, and self-hosted server with a private API. - **50+ PDF tools** - Edit, merge, split, sign, redact, convert, OCR, compress, and more. - **Automation & workflows** - No-code pipelines direct in UI with APIs to process millions of PDFs. - **Enterprise‑grade** - SSO, auditing, and flexible on‑prem deployments. - **Developer platform** - REST APIs available for nearly all tools to integrate into your existing systems. - **Global UI** - Interface available in 40+ languages. For a full feature list, see the docs: **https://docs.stirlingpdf.com** ## Quick Start ```bash docker run -p 8080:8080 docker.stirlingpdf.com/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf ``` Then open: http://localhost:8080 For full installation options (including desktop and Kubernetes), see our [Documentation Guide](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/#documentation-guide). ## Resources - [**Documentation**](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com) - [**Homepage**](https://stirling.com) - [**API Docs**](https://registry.scalar.com/@stirlingpdf/apis/stirling-pdf-processing-api/) - [**Server Plan & Enterprise**](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/Paid-Offerings) ## Support - **Community**: [Discord](https://discord.gg/HYmhKj45pU) - **Bug Reports**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/issues) ## Contributing We welcome contributions! Please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines. This project uses [Task](https://taskfile.dev/) as a unified command runner for all build, dev, and test commands. Run `task dev` to get started running the editor, run `task` to see the most common commands, or see the [Developer Guide](docs/developer/DeveloperGuide.md) for full details. For adding translations, see the [Translation Guide](docs/developer/HowToAddNewLanguage.md). ## License Stirling PDF is open-core. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details.
